title: "Comparison"
output: html_document

Avergae glmm and gam2
```{r}
library(sf)

#glmm
prediction_rast_env <- unwrap(prediction_rast_env)

#GAM2 
prediction_rast_env_gam_k <- unwrap(prediction_rast_env_gam_k)

prediction_rast_env <- rast("prediction_rast_env.rds")
prediction_rast_env_gam_k <- rast("prediction_rast_env_gam_k.rds")

#average the two
pred_avg <- (prediction_rast_env + prediction_rast_env_gam_k) / 2

#plot
plot(pred_avg)

#change colours and plot indivudal layers
plot(
  pred_avg[[2]],
  col = colorRampPalette(c(
    "#4575b4", "#74add1", "#91bfdb",
    "#fee090", "#fc8d59", "#d73027"
  ))(100),
  main = "SE Fit"
)



```
